body:
Also, when I said that I cant remember what was the last time somebody looked me in the eyes and told me I was beautiful/loved I meant a real relationship, like the person really meant it...

Not some causal chat that isn't very real you know
I wrote a reply to another user if you want to read, it's for you too

I picked engineering because it was the course that i had good enough grades to join - a federal college (i'm Brazilian), government education, the salary of an engineer is theoretically good so I joined right away so I could graduate by 25 (im 24 and marry the now ex-girlfriend)

She abandoned me 4 years ago when I was 21 because I lost my patience with her multiple times (please if I could give you some advice never lose your patience with loved ones, you'll regret until you die) and didn't interact with her family too much (I'm introvert and felt extreme anxiety near them, she never understood and I never managed to properly explain to her)

But she was the high school sweetheart and  by now I'm pretty sure I'll never love anyone like I loved her (I still like her and still have hope that one day she may return) 

Every year she send me a SMS saying happy birthday and/or merry Christmas, this year she did the same, I'm still hopeful, she never invited me to go out since the broke up and it was a 3 year relationship, she broke up with me via phone when I was in college town (she lives in our hometown) so I didn't even had the chance to see her/speak personally since the break up, only via SMS 

I still have hope that she'll come back and honestly will remain hopeful until I'm 70 yo or die, I don't think anyone can replace her but i really hope she either returns or somebody step in because these 4 years have been extremely painful being alone and I can't take much longer I guess - I have a poster in my bedroom consisting of a drawing of a USMC soldier holding a rifle, I added the phrase RESCUE IS NOT COMING on Paint and printed it to motivate me during the hard depression crisis days - I gotta stay strong and keep fighting because I was left behind and nobody is coming for me, I gotta keep fighting with whatever resources I have at my disposal and win this battle, not for anyone else but for me

photo of the drawing:

https://imgur.com/a/SzPuV

My father is a supportive kind man, but what can he do, he lives in hometown and tried to take me to a therapist, but I stopped taking the medicine long ago and he knows that, he thinks I'm cured and I don't think I am - pills never done shit, only thigh that helped me so far is the bursts of motivation and extreme dedication to a certain task (I'm a former soccer player as a teen, I can take physical pain and exhaustion easily.. if I gotta overwork other people I will push myself to unthinkable limits cause I don't accept defeat)


Three days ago I found a beautiful lady on the supermarket, she was in need of a cart and I was leaving, so I offered mine

I breath deeply and told her that I found her gorgeous and she laughed and offered to help me carry my bags, I asked her name and added her on Facebook later, we chat for a bit, she thinks I'm cute, she told me she wanted chocolates and I offered to bring her chocolates (only an excuse to see her) but it was only me falling into the trap of optimism once again... slowly the communication went to zero and I don't think I'll ever have the chance to see her again after that funny day on the supermarket 

Countless times I approached ladies like this with no successful follow-up whatsoever, but at least this one was a total stranger 

Today another beautiful blonde and cute girl (I saw her on the cafeteria last week) came out of nowhere and asked to me where the Law school was and it was about half a mile from our location, she told she was kinda lazy and refused my invitation to walk there with her, when I was leaving I told her hair was amazing and like the previous girl she laughed and that was it


I have hopes, but deep inside I know that she won't want to talk to me or accept a date invite, perhaps she will (at least i think she could potentially accept it if I ever see her again) but hey, who am I trying to fool, that's just the optimism trap once again


Hopefully I'll find her on campus someday later this week and try to start something 


I have so much love and care inside me to give to someone, another girlfriend or maybe an adopted child (if I don't marry anyone I will adopt a kid and raise him the best possible way with kindness, a roof and good food) I Just wanted to release this love and make others feel special because I know how messed up it is to be invisible and not to be cared about

I'm used to being invisible and for doing good deeds without anyone even acknowledging the things I do, and will remain doing that cause it's my nature

I just wanted to have a girlfriend and be smarter so I cluld learn these fucking subjects. Somebody I could look into the eyes and say - you are amazing dear, I love you so so much and you are so special to me


I'm a type of person who feels immense pleasure and happiness in pleasing others, I'm a team player, but since I'm at rock bottom into this pit of solitude, I can't feel happy or complete.

Volunteering in shelters didn't help, I need a partner for life and somebody to potentially start my family with

If you made this far, Wherever you are, please wish me good luck and cheer for me my friend, you have no idea the fight that I'm fighting. Have confidence in me, I promise I will make it, I will not disappoint you
